{{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 9|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = [[Tactician]]|weakness = [[Tech]]|image1 = File:Class Use Demolitions.png}}'''Demolitions''' are one of six Bot Classes in ''[[Transformers: Forged to Fight]]''. It has a Class Bonus against [[Tactician]], but is weak to [[Tech]].

==In-Game Description==
''Demolitions Bots are burst damage experts that buff their Special Attacks for bigger, bolder, explosions.''
*The fewer, but critical high-damage attacks of the [[Demolition]] Bots give them an advantage over [[Tactician]] Bots.
*[[Tech]] Bots' shields and Power reducing abilites are effective against [[Demolition]] Bots.

== Strategies ==
Staying true to their name, Demolitions bots bring the noise by amping up their Special Attacks in their quest to overpower and overrun. Their Crit chance is fairly low but their Crit damage is very high. Their affinity for burst damage flows in their blood and they deal massive damage with their special attacks.

[[Tech]] Bots love to play antics against a Demolitions Bot by draining their power and defending against their heavy-hitting Special.

==List of Demolition Bots==
*[[Ironhide]]
*[[Mixmaster]]
*[[Waspinator]]
*[[Megatron (ROTF)]]
*[[Ramjet]]
*[[Galvatron]]
*Demolitions [[Sharkticon]]
*[[Megatronus]]
*[[Cliffjumper]]
